mapper.select: WITH TEMP AS ( SELECT * FROM( select sys_data_process_mark.*,rank() over(partition by sys_data_process_mark.workflow_id order by sys_data_process_mark.HIS_NO desc) as rank from sys_data_process_mark inner join SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST on SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST.seq_no = sys_data_process_mark.workflow_id and SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST.PROCESS_STATE not in ('END','NEW') where sys_data_process_mark.page_id in ('FinProductFeePay002','FinProductFeePay004','FinproductPayTheVatQuery002','FinProductQuotation002','FinResultsCovering002') or sys_data_process_mark.page_id in ('FinProductRateQuotation002','FinProductBmQuotation002','FinFloatMgtExpQuotation002') ) WHERE rank = 1 ), /*净值型产品存续期*/ TEMP1 AS( SELECT A.*, case when a.profitType = '01' then replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.business_data,'"'||amtStr||'":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"'||amtStr||'":"',''),'"','') when a.profitType = '03' then replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.business_data,'"'||amtStr||'03'||'":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"'||amtStr||'03'||'":"',''),'"','') else null end as tradeAmt FROM( select A.*, replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(business_data,'"profitType":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"profitType":"',''),'"','') profitType, case when a.business_data_pk3 = 'C1' then 'subDealAmt' when a.business_data_pk3 = 'C2' then 'purDealAmt' when a.business_data_pk3 in ('C4','C17','C18') then 'redTotalNetValue' when a.business_data_pk3 in ('C5','C20') then 'expireDealAmt' when a.business_data_pk3 in ('C3','C6') then 'addReduceDealAmt' when a.business_data_pk3 = 'C9' then 'bonusCashBonusAmt' when a.business_data_pk3 = 'C10' then 'bonusCashBonusAmt' else '' end as amtStr, rank() over(partition by A.workflow_id order by A.HIS_NO desc) as rank from sys_data_process_mark A inner join SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST B on B.seq_no = A.workflow_id and B.PROCESS_STATE not in ('END','NEW') where a.page_id = 'FinNetProductDuration' )A WHERE rank = 1 ), deal as( select * from( select deal.*,rank() over(partition by deal.workflow_id order by deal.update_time desc) as rank from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal )where rank = 1 ) SELECT T.create_user as launchUser, nvl(pp.PORTFOLIO_ID,fp.finprod_market_id) AS portfolioId, nvl(pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME,fp.FINPROD_ABBR) as portfolioName, t.trade_id tradeId, tdeal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totleTradeId, case when tdeal.trade_amt ='' or tdeal.trade_amt is null then decode(deal.trade_amt,'',null,deal.trade_amt) else decode(tdeal.trade_amt,'',null,tdeal.trade_amt) end as tradeAmt, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T INNER JOIN DEAL ON deal.workflow_id = T.seq_no and T.PROCESS_STATE not in ('END','NEW') left join wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total tdeal on deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tdeal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code left join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_id = deal.finprod_id left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = tdeal.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE deal.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' and T.crt_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} union select launchUser, portfolioId, portfolioName, tradeId, totleTradeId, decode(tradeAmt,'',null,tradeAmt) tradeAmt, nextUser, createTaskTime, instCode from( SELECT T.create_user as launchUser, pp.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME as portfolioName, T.trade_id tradeId, '' totleTradeId, case when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay002' then replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"actPayAmt":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"actPayAmt":"',''),'"','') when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay004' then replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"ActPayAmtSum":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"ActPayAmtSum":"',''),'"','') when temp.page_id = 'FinproductPayTheVatQuery002' then replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"tradeAmt":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"tradeAmt":"',''),'"','') when temp.page_id = 'FinResultsCovering002' then replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(temp.business_data,'"actualAmount":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"actualAmount":"',''),'"','') else null end as tradeAmt, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T INNER JOIN TEMP on T.seq_no = temp.workflow_id and temp.page_id in ('FinProductFeePay002','FinProductFeePay004','FinproductPayTheVatQuery002','FinProductQuotation002','FinResultsCovering002') LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on (case when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay002' then temp.business_data_pk1 when temp.page_id = 'FinProductFeePay004' then regexp_replace(temp.business_data_pk2,'^F16_','') when temp.page_id = 'FinproductPayTheVatQuery002' then regexp_replace(temp.business_data_pk2,'^F16_','') when temp.page_id = 'FinResultsCovering002' then regexp_replace(temp.business_data_pk2,'^F16_','') else regexp_replace(temp.business_data_pk1,'^F16_','') end) = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T.crt_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) union select T.create_user as launchUser, pp.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME as portfolioName, T.trade_id as tradeId, '' totleTradeId, decode(temp1.tradeAmt,'',null,temp1.tradeAmt) tradeAmt, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode from SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T INNER JOIN temp1 on T.seq_no = temp1.workflow_id LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on regexp_replace(temp1.business_data_pk2,'^F16_','') = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T.crt_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} /*添加 产品费率报价调整、产品业绩基准调整、浮动管理费报价调整*/ union select T.create_user as launchUser, pp.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME as portfolioName, T.trade_id as tradeId, '' totleTradeId, null tradeAmt, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T inner join temp on temp.workflow_id = t.seq_no and temp.page_id in ('FinProductRateQuotation002','FinProductBmQuotation002','FinFloatMgtExpQuotation002') LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = ( case when temp.page_id = 'FinProductRateQuotation002' then regexp_replace(temp.business_data_pk3,'^F16_','') when temp.page_id = 'FinProductBmQuotation002' then regexp_replace(temp.business_data_pk1,'^F16_','') when temp.page_id = 'business_data_pk1' then regexp_replace(temp.business_data_pk1,'^F16_','') else '' end ) WHERE T.crt_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}
